description: A Java class 'SignatureSourcer' that extends ASM's SignatureVisitor to generate Java source code from type signatures, including handling generics, method signatures, and class hierarchies.

classes.name: SignatureSourcer
classes.description: A class extending SignatureVisitor to generate Java source code from signatures, handling generics, class types, method signatures, and type arguments.

methods.name: getBuf
methods.description: Returns the current StringBuilder buffer based on whether formals are being written.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the signature.

methods.name: getReturnType
methods.description: Returns the SignatureSourcer representing the return type.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Returns the list of SignatureSourcer objects for method parameters.

methods.name: hasFormalsContent
methods.description: Checks if the formal type parameters buffer has content.

methods.name: formalsToString
methods.description: Returns the string of formal type parameters.

methods.name: getSuperClass
methods.description: Returns the SignatureSourcer representing the super class.
